"Create a simple playable 2D game.

The player controls a small blue character that can move left and right and jump.

The goal is to collect 5 coins while avoiding red enemies.

Features:

- Simple colorful graphics.
- Keyboard controls.
- Score counter.
- Win screen when all coins are collected.
- Restart button.

Make the game fully playable. Keep the code simple and avoid unnecessary features.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.
"
